summary.intent: Update PR #431's description to match its new design (a dedicated always-run release-pr-note job), then open a small follow-up PR closing the leftover low-severity review findings from the merged PRs #428 and #430.
summary.outcome: PR #431's description was rewritten and it is mergeable again. A new branch test/review-followups was committed and pushed with test fixes: E239 asserted for the no-origin run, a new unreachable-origin end-to-end test, a matrix sort test moved to use module helpers, and the E007 test using the harness stderr_of. Tests and clippy passed; the PR number and trail link output were not shown.

repo: Release PR state is a single comment marked `<!-- callisto-release-pr-state -->`, edited in place. It is written by hold-release-pr.sh (held) and note-release-pr-rebuild.sh (ready or draft), both via release-pr-note.sh.
The release-pr-note job must be its own always-run job. When verify or release-candidate fails, version-pr is skipped, so a step inside version-pr would never run.
The release workflow policy needed to allow that one job to write pull requests.
A release preview run without an origin fails with E239 (a workspace with artifact slots cannot release locally), not E132 as the reviewer suspected.
Tests can simulate an unreachable git remote deterministically with GIT_SSH_COMMAND=false.
The CLI integration tests have a shared harness helper `stderr_of` in crates/callisto-cli/tests/common/release_harness.rs, so local stderr copies are redundant.

Local verification for CI changes covers shellcheck -x, actionlint, zizmor, and the release policy and contract checks. Release-notes behavior is covered by .github/tests/test-release-pr-notes.sh (12 cases) and test-hold-release-pr.sh.
Trails are linked to branches with `entire trail link <n> --repo --project --branch --base`.

code.finding: The no-origin preview test now asserts E239, and a new test makes origin unreachable via GIT_SSH_COMMAND=false and asserts the preview still plans with no git error output.
The local `stderr` helper was removed in favor of the harness `stderr_of`, and the E007 test now also asserts that `init` exits 1, matching `version`.
The two_release_artifacts matrix sort test was rewritten to use the module's own helpers and moved next to the other add_release_artifact_groups tests.

workflow: Run the real code path to see what a test actually reports before asserting on it. This showed the reviewer's expected E132 was wrong and the real code is E239.
Use a bulk sed substitution, then grep to check the result. The first sed left residual `stderr(&` calls and needed a second pass.
Group leftover low-severity review findings from several merged PRs into one small follow-up PR.
Run cargo fmt, the targeted tests, and clippy with -D warnings before committing.

friction: The reviewer's expectation of E132 for the no-origin run was wrong, so the first test run failed and had to be investigated.
The first sed to replace the stderr helper did not catch every call site, so a second sed pass was needed.
The work ran in a Claude worktree directory named macos-15-runners, not a dedicated one.
The new PR number and trail link output were not visible in the transcript.
open_items: The release-pr-note comment has not been verified on a real held release PR. The first push to main with an open release PR will be the first real run.
PR #431 is still blocked on the Entire approval and checks.
The PR for test/review-followups still needs its number confirmed and its trail 176 link checked.
